address: Taman Jurong Market & Food Centre, #03-146, 3 Yung Sheng Road, Jurong West, 618499, Singapore
bio: This popular stall offers lor mee with generous toppings like meatballs and fish flakes. The noodles are springy and the broth is tasty and flavoursome. Also, try their deep-fried prawn rolls with a crispy skin and juicy filling....
